Here is the clean, complete set of 20 consistent prompts for the Mysteries of the Rosary in the **Modern Australian modernist oil painting** style, formatted for a **3:4 portrait aspect ratio**.

---

### The Joyful Mysteries

1. **The Annunciation**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Annunciation beside a weathered, rustic timber homestead verandah. Under a corrugated iron roof, a young woman (Mary) in simple, earth-toned linen sits on a timber bench, looking in wonder toward a radiant, ethereal angel of warm golden light appearing on the red-earth ground. On the right, towering silver-grey eucalyptus trees with peeling bark and brilliant splashes of golden wattle in bloom catch clear southern sunlight piercing through the leaves. Expressive, thick impasto brushwork, luminous ochres, sienna, sage green, and a vast cobalt sky. A sacred, quiet atmosphere, no text.


2. **The Visitation**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Visitation. On a rocky, granite-strewn hillside overlooking a vast expanse of rolling Australian bushland and distant blue ranges, Mary and Elizabeth embrace warmly near a weathered timber fence line. They are dressed in simple traveler’s clothing of dusty rose and natural ochre, capturing a moment of profound, quiet affection. Gnarled silver-grey gum trees, dry scrub, and native grasses catch the warm, dusty morning light. The background fades into hazy blue and sage valleys under a soft, luminous dawn sky. Thick impasto strokes, rich earthy tones, no text.


3. **The Nativity**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Nativity inside an open-sided, rustic timber and corrugated iron shearing shed at night. Mary and Joseph, wearing simple, dark rustic clothing, kneel beside a wooden manger filled with dry bush grass, from which a soft, miraculous golden light emanates, illuminating the humble shelter and their faces. Nearby, a few sheep rest in the dust. Outside, the vast, dark indigo Australian outback is dotted with silhouetted gum trees under a spectacular, starry Southern Cross night sky. Thick, expressive impasto brushwork, deep indigo, burnt sienna, and brilliant gold highlights, sacred and intimate, no text.


4. **The Presentation**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Presentation in a contemporary, open-sided bush chapel constructed from rough-hewn sandstone and massive timber pillars. Elderly Simeon, in weathered ochre and off-white garments, reverently holds the infant Jesus, bathed in a brilliant, warm shaft of natural sunlight pouring through high timber rafters. Mary and Joseph stand nearby in humble, simple attire. In the background, the dusty red-earth landscape and silver-grey gum trees are visible beyond the chapel’s natural rock boundaries. Bold, painterly strokes, luminous amber, crimson, and deep ultramarine palette, no text.


5. **The Finding in the Temple**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Finding in the Temple, reimagined in the sun-drenched, open sandstone courtyard of a rural community mission. A twelve-year-old Jesus, wearing a simple dusty linen tunic, sits calmly on a stone bench, gesturing expressively as he converses with elder bush teachers who listen intently in rugged, natural-toned garments. Towering red gums, flowering bottlebrush, and dry scrub border the courtyard under a hot, blazing midday sky. Rich ochre, terracotta, and deep eucalyptus sage-green, heavy textured brushwork, capturing natural sunlight and crisp shadows, no text.



---

### The Luminous Mysteries

6. **The Baptism in the Jordan**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Baptism of Jesus in a deep, natural bush river gully. Jesus stands waist-deep in the shimmering water of a river lined with massive, gnarled river red gums, smooth granite boulders, and fallen timber. John the Baptist, in rough-hewn bush garments, pours water over his head. Above them, a dramatic, blinding burst of golden and white celestial light in the shape of a dove pierces the canopy from a deep, turbulent cobalt sky, illuminating the water and dense bush. Highly expressive, thick impasto, rich greens, deep earthy ochres, and radiant white-gold, no text.


7. **The Wedding at Cana**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Wedding at Cana, set at an outdoor celebratory gathering under a rustic timber pergola draped with leafy grapevines. Against a backdrop of sun-drenched, undulating Australian vineyard hills and distant bush, a crowd in casual, earthy attire gathers around long timber tables. On the left, Mary gestures toward several large, rustic clay water jars, where Jesus stands quietly nearby as a subtle golden warmth illuminates the jars turning into deep ruby wine. Rich, warm afternoon sunlight, textured ochre, olive green, burgundy, and deep cobalt, festive and earthy, no text.


8. **The Proclamation of the Kingdom**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Proclamation of the Kingdom. Jesus, wearing a simple, dusty earth-toned cloak, stands on a rugged, windswept red-earth outback escarpment, gesturing outward as he speaks to a diverse gathering of travelers, workers, and families seated on rocks and red ground. The vast, flat Australian horizon extends behind them, dotted with sparse saltbush, spinifex, and gnarled mulga trees beneath a towering, dramatic cerulean sky with swirling white clouds. Expressive, heavily textured brushwork, rich burnt sienna, deep ochre, and bright sky-blue, a sense of vastness and revelation, no text.


9. **The Transfiguration**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Transfiguration. Atop a rugged Australian alpine peak with twisted, pale snow gums and massive granite boulders, Jesus is transfigured, erupting in dazzling, blinding white and golden light. He is flanked by the luminous, ethereal silhouettes of Moses and Elijah. Below them on the rocky ground, three disciples shield their eyes in awe. A dramatic, swirling sky of deep violet, indigo, and intense gold breaks overhead. Heavy, expressive impasto, sharp contrasts of dark alpine brush and blinding celestial light, no text.


10. **The Institution of the Eucharist**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Institution of the Eucharist. Inside an open, rustic sandstone and timber bush shelter, Jesus and his disciples are gathered around a long, weathered red-gum table at dusk. Warm candlelight and fading twilight illuminate the scene. Jesus, in natural linen, breaks bread beside a humble cup of red wine as his companions lean in with solemn, expressive faces. Through the open structure, the darkening Australian bush with silhouetted gum trees is visible under a deep indigo and amber twilight sky. Rich, heavy texture, intimate and sacred, no text.



---

### The Sorrowful Mysteries

11. **The Agony in the Garden**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Agony in the Garden. Jesus, in dark, worn garments, kneels in anguished prayer among the gnarled, twisted trunks of old eucalyptus and tea-trees on a rocky, dark bush hillside at night. Cold, silver moonlight and deep, shadowy indigoes envelop the tangled undergrowth, while a solitary, faint golden beam of divine comfort pierces the heavy, turbulent night sky. Expressive, thick impasto brushwork, conveying raw spiritual intensity, muted sage, deep charcoal, and natural earthy darks, no text.


12. **The Scourging at the Pillar**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Scourging at the Pillar. In a stark, sun-bleached courtyard of corrugated iron and weathered sandstone, Jesus is bound to a rough-hewn, upright ironbark timber pillar. Heavily shadowed figures stand around him in the harsh, high-contrast midday Australian sun. The composition focuses on Jesus' quiet, dignified endurance amidst dry dirt, debris, and weathered timber fences. Heavy, expressive palette-knife and brush textures, muted ochre, charcoal, and glints of deep crimson, capturing a raw, solemn atmosphere, no text.


13. **The Crowning with Thorns**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Crowning with Thorns. In a dimly lit, open-ended outback shed, Jesus sits in quiet, majestic suffering, wearing a crown woven from dry, spiky Australian acacia and desert thorn scrub. Figures in rugged, dark bushmen's clothing stand around him, with one placing a tattered, reddish-ochre cloak over his shoulders. Rough, heavy brushwork and thick impasto paint capture the tense environment, illuminated by harsh, angular natural light from the open doorway, highlighting his bowed, resilient figure. Deep burnt sienna, ash-grey, and dull crimson, no text.


14. **The Carrying of the Cross**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Carrying of the Cross. Jesus, bowed under the heavy weight of a rough, massive ironbark cross, stumbles along a dusty, red-earth track winding up a barren, sun-baked ridge. A sparse crowd of onlookers in weathered outback attire is scattered along the path, while dry scrub and dead gum trees dot the desolate landscape. A blazing, heavy copper and ochre sky hangs overhead. Dramatic, long shadows, highly textured, expressive brushwork, capturing natural dust, exhaustion, and perseverance, no text.


15. **The Crucifixion**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Crucifixion on a high, rocky coastal headland overlooking a dark, tumultuous southern ocean. Jesus hangs on a rough-hewn timber cross against a dramatic, bruised sky filled with swirling violet, charcoal, and fiery amber storm clouds. At the base of the cross, the grief-stricken figures of Mary and John stand amidst windswept scrub and coastal banksia, bathed in a solemn, fading golden light. Heavy, textured impasto brushwork, deep ocean blues, earthy ochres, and dark crimson, no text.



---

### The Glorious Mysteries

16. **The Resurrection**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Resurrection. Outside a rock-cut tomb nestled in a native bushland gully, a blinding, explosive burst of dawn golden and white light breaks through the morning mist, illuminating the open sandstone rock. The risen Christ stands in luminous, vibrant splendor, transcending the dark earth. Around the tomb, dew-covered ferns, banksias, and silver-grey eucalyptus leaves catch the fiery sunrise colors of gold, coral, and deep cobalt. Expressive, thick, joyful impasto brushwork, capturing a victorious awakening, no text.


17. **The Ascension**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Ascension. The risen Christ ascends into a vast, luminous southern sky filled with swirling clouds of gold, white, and cerulean blue above a rugged coastal cliffside. Below, on the clifftop among coastal banksia and windswept heath, the disciples look upward in awe, bathed in spectacular heavenly rays. A soaring vertical composition, with thick, energetic brushwork capturing the transition from the rugged, earthy coastline to the infinite, glowing sky. Natural ochres, deep blues, and brilliant celestial golds, no text.


18. **The Descent of the Holy Spirit**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Descent of the Holy Spirit. Inside a large, open-air bush hall built of rough-hewn sandstone and massive timber beams, Mary and the apostles are gathered together, looking upward as vibrant, swirling tongues of golden-orange and crimson fire descend upon them. Dynamic, intense bursts of warm divine light fill the space, illuminating the rustic interior and their energized faces, with dry daylight bush visible beyond the timber columns. Bold, sweeping brushstrokes, rich reds, ambers, and deep shadows, no text.


19. **The Assumption**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Assumption of Mary. Mary is borne upward toward a vast, star-speckled twilight southern sky, surrounded by luminous, swirling clouds of pearl, rose-gold, and deep ultramarine. Below, the quiet landscape of Australian coastal waters and silhouetted eucalyptus headlands fades into dusk. Graceful ascending motion, depicted with heavy, layered, expressive oil paint, creating a serene and poetic atmosphere, no text.


20. **The Coronation of Mary**
> A modern Australian modernist oil painting in the expressive, textured style of Arthur Boyd and Sidney Nolan, 3:4 aspect ratio, depicting the Coronation of Mary. In a radiant, celestial expanse opening directly above a quiet, dark Australian horizon of bush and rolling hills, Mary is crowned Queen of Heaven in glory. She is surrounded by swirling, brilliant clouds of gold, sapphire, and emerald light, with the stars of the Southern Cross subtly echoing in the heavens above. A majestic, triumphant composition with thick, rich impasto brushwork and jewel-like tones, no text.

A modern Australian modernist oil painting with expressive, thick impasto brushwork and a raw, textured, mid-century feel, 3:4 portrait orientation. A rough-hewn timber cross of grey weathered ironbark stands on a red-earth rise in the Australian bush at first light, with the solemn figure of Christ upon it. A complete rosary of carved wooden beads hangs from the foot of the cross and lies looped on the red earth and native grasses in the foreground, the medal, the short chain of five beads and the circle of beads all clearly visible. Behind, silver-grey eucalyptus trees with peeling bark, golden wattle in bloom, and a vast dawn sky of cobalt, rose and gold, with three soft rays of light breaking through the clouds. Luminous ochres, burnt sienna, sage green and cobalt blue, quiet, sacred and hopeful, no text, no lettering, no signature, no initials, no watermark.

A modern Australian modernist oil painting with expressive, thick impasto brushwork and a raw, textured, mid-century feel, 3:4 portrait orientation. At dusk on a rocky headland above the southern ocean, Mary stands as Queen and Mother of Mercy, wearing a simple crown and a deep blue mantle that she spreads wide with both arms. Gathered under her mantle are ordinary Australians in earthy working clothes: farmers, a mother holding a child, an old shearer, a young student, kneeling or standing close with hands joined in prayer. A rosary hangs from Mary's hand. Behind her, the Southern Cross appears in a deep indigo and amber twilight sky, and silhouetted coastal banksia and windswept gum trees line the cliff edge. Rich ultramarine, ochre, coral and gold, tender, protective and peaceful, no text, no lettering, no signature, no initials, no watermark.
